description: Hooks for the ci-moonrepo plugin. SessionStart injects a moonrepo-workspace orientation when .moon/ is detected. PreToolUse on Edit|Write|MultiEdit guards moon-config edits: hard-denies the forbidden top-level .moon/tasks.yml, soft-warns when a .moon/tasks/*.yml lacks an 'inheritedBy:' block, and emits a generic skill-pointer context for any other .moon/, moon.yml, .prototools, or rust-toolchain.toml edit. PreToolUse on Bash hard-denies moon ci/run/exec/query invocations that reference \${{ github.event.before }} (the zero-SHA production trap), and soft-warns moon ci invocations missing explicit --base/--head or MOON_BASE/MOON_HEAD. UserPromptSubmit pattern-matches the prompt for moon-CI topics and injects the skill pointer plus the four key rules. Wired via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}; all hot paths short-circuit in <5ms when no moon context is present.
